# Enrollment requests must match the Protocol and current Dataset

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll an Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Scout One",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [
      {
        "cancellation": true,
        "command_id": "move_to",
        "progress": true,
        "scheduling": [
          "queued"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "health": {
        "battery_percent": 75
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      },
      "telemetry": {
        "latitude": 42.2743,
        "longitude": -71.8081
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": "ground vehicle",
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 2. Prepare a second Asset identity

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

## 3. An unknown field is rejected

direct `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>",
  "unexpected": "ignored data"
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "message": "The request does not match the Protocol at /: property \"unexpected\" is unsupported."
}
```

## 4. A malformed credential is rejected without echoing it

direct `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "atlas_asset_short"
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "message": "The request does not match the Protocol at /credential: string doesn't match the regular expression \"^atlas_asset_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$\"."
}
```

## 5. Latitude without longitude is rejected

direct `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42
    }
  }
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "message": "Latitude and longitude must be supplied together."
}
```

## 6. An enrollment for another Dataset conflicts

direct `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<old dataset>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "dataset_changed",
  "message": "The request belongs to another Dataset."
}
```

## 7. An alias differing only in case conflicts

direct `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>",
  "alias": "scout one"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "registration_conflict",
  "message": "The registration identity or facts conflict."
}
```
